{{Top|leg}}
'''Duratape''' was an adhesive tape that was packaged in rolls. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Lofryyhn]], [[Chief engineer/Legends|chief engineer]] of the ''[[FarStar]]'', carried a roll of duratape in his satchel that he used to keep the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] in working order.<ref name="The DarkStryder Campaign">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>{{Tech-stub}}
